title: Prompt Capability Profile
description: One ACCEPTED capability profile per canonical prompt. Direct assignments own behavior; inherited sources are versioned references. Candidate inference may only produce PROVISIONAL profiles.

schema_version.description: Schema identifier for this profile instance.

prompt_id.description: Stable prompt identity. Must match a canonical prompt record.

profile_version.description: Monotonic version for this prompt_id. First accepted baseline is version 1.

profile_sha256.description: SHA-256 of canonical profile JSON (sorted keys, UTF-8) excluding this field; used for migration chaining.

canonical_sha256.description: Hash of the canonical prompt record (source.sha256) this profile was built against. Fails PSC002 if it diverges from current topology.

registry_path.description: Canonical registry file that contributed this prompt, e.g., docs/prompts.json.

prompt_path.description: Logical prompt path for provenance, e.g., prompts/P07.

acceptance_revision.description: Git commit SHA at which this profile was ACCEPTED. PROVISIONAL profiles may use a candidate revision.

status.description: Only ACCEPTED profiles are regression priors. Candidate generators may emit only PROVISIONAL.

prior_profile_sha256.description: Previous ACCEPTED profile hash when version >1; null for version 1.

direct_assignments.description: Capabilities directly owned by this prompt's body. Each entry is a capability cell.

capability_id.description: Must resolve to semantic-capability-catalog.v1.json via PSC003.

evidence_refs.description: Repository-owned proof references. Required when presence is REQUIRED or ownership is PRIMARY or relation is FORBIDDEN.

inherited_sources.description: Versioned shared sources that contribute capabilities without copying N times. The derived matrix expands these.

revision.description: SHA-256 of the shared source at acceptance time. PSC016 requires revalidation when this changes.

capabilities.description: Capability IDs contributed by this inherited source with their presence/ownership as defined by the source.

semantic_fingerprint.description: Hash of (canonical_sha256 + sorted direct assignments + sorted inherited_sources identities). Used for drift detection.

evidence_refs.description: Top-level evidence references for the profile as a whole, e.g., ontology evidence or topology proof.

tombstone.description: True only for RETIRED profiles. Never reuse the P-number.
